candidates.description: This vector represents the concept of gambling, casinos, and games of chance.

These tokens represent the concept of structural, relational, or compositional verbs, particularly common in Romance languages and English equivalents denoting makeup, correspondence, or representation.
This vector represents common French conjunctive and adverbial modifiers indicating time, manner, or logical progression.
This feature vector represents demonstrative determiners and related modifiers used to point to specific nouns or entities.
This vector represents distinct units of written content, information, or physical systems.
This feature vector represents the root concept of action, deeds, and active intervention.
This vector represents adjectives and adverbs that describe degrees of possibility, frequency, complexity, or importance.
This vector represents modal verbs and auxiliary verbs used to express possibility, necessity, or capability across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on subword tokens and prefixes starting with the letters "ap" or containing common word fragments resembling "app" and related variations.
This feature vector represents socio-political and cultural terminology, particularly adjectives and nouns related to societal, political, and local contexts in French and English.
